english.title: PHV operator fail to produce to PC/ authorised officer records - London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a London private hire vehicle, failed to produce for inspection at the request of

(A)_[a police constable]_
(B)_[an authorised officer]_

a record required by section 4 of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998 to be kept, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RECORD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(3)(e) and (5) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

english.notes:
(i) Section 4(4) provides that if a London PHV operator ceases to use an operating centre specified in his licence he shall preserve any record he was required by this section to keep there for such period as may be prescribed.
(ii) Section 4(6) provides a defence in proceedings for this offence for an operator to show that he exercised all due diligence to avoid committing such an offence.
